name: fem shell: a 100 × 20 × 2 steel strip
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [100, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [100, 0], b: [100, 20] }, { kind: 'line', a: [100, 20], b: [0, 20] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 20], b: [0, 0] }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 2 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, faces: m.state.partEntry.faces.length }); })()

name: fem shell: the strip as a cantilever on its mid-surface bends like the solid study (tip within 5 %), thickness measured, fields on the part
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.loadKind = 'force'; e.dir = '-z'; e.magnitude = 10; e.elementSize = 2; e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 0), 'fixed')]; e.loads = [mk(at('x', 100))]; e.result = null; const solid = await run(); const dSolid = solid.maxDisplacement; m.actions.pmToggle('fem.shell', true); await sleep(100); const picking = e.pick === 'shellFaces' && Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-pick="shellFaces"]')); const top = all.find((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE' && Math.abs(x.f.center.z - 2) < 1e-6); e.shellFaces = [{ index: top.index, faceId: top.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.result = null; const r = await run(); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ picking, ok: r?.ok, kind: r?.kind, t: +(r?.thickness ?? 0).toFixed(3), close: Math.abs(r.maxDisplacement / dSolid - 1) < 0.05, colours: r.vertexStress?.length === m.state.partEntry.mesh.vertices.length / 3, shown: Boolean(document.querySelector('.fem-shell-results')), adaptiveHidden: !document.querySelector('[data-pm-toggle="fem.adaptive"]'), v: [dSolid, r.maxDisplacement, r.elements] }); })()

name: fem shell: the result on the model, deformed
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.pmToggle('deformed', true); await m.run('isometric'); await m.run('zoomFit'); await sleep(900); document.querySelector('.fem-shell-results')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(200); return /예기치 않은 오류|Unexpected error/.test(document.body.innerText) ? 'crashed' : 'ok'; })()

name: fem shell: with no faces picked it asks for them
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; e.shellFaces = []; e.result = null; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ result: e.result, pick: e.pick }); })()
